video_summary.overall_goal: The user appears to open the allowed-host list, search for a hostname, try to add a hostname to the whitelist, and return to the list.
video_summary.description: The recording shows the AdAway app. The user opens the allowed list area, uses search, types a short query, opens an add-host dialog, enters and clears text, applies or saves a change, then returns to the list screen where one allowed-list item is visible.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The AdAway home screen is visible with a red header and status cards for blocked, allowed, and redirected requests.
steps.system_response: The app navigates away from the home dashboard to the allowed-list area.
steps.navigation_change: AdAway home screen to Your lists screen
steps.visual_feedback: The screen changes from the red dashboard to a dark list screen.
steps.intent_task: Open the list of allowed hosts.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen is visible with the Allowed tab selected. The list area appears empty.
steps.system_response: The search field opens at the top of the screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The title area changes into a search input with placeholder text.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A search field is active at the top of the Your lists screen and the Android keyboard is open.
steps.system_response: The typed query appears in the search field.
steps.visual_feedback: The search field updates with the typed text and the list area remains empty.
steps.intent_task: Look for a matching hostname in the allowed list.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The search screen remains open with the query visible and the red plus button near the lower-right side.
steps.system_response: A dialog opens for adding a host to the whitelist.
steps.visual_feedback: A centered dialog appears over the list screen.
steps.intent_task: Add a new hostname to the allowed or whitelist list.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: A dialog titled Add host to whitelist is visible with a Hostname input field.
steps.system_response: Text appears in the hostname field.
steps.visual_feedback: The Hostname field shows entered text and the cursor remains active.
steps.intent_task: Enter a hostname to add to the whitelist.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Add host to whitelist dialog remains open with the keyboard visible.
steps.system_response: The entered hostname text is removed and the placeholder text becomes visible again.
steps.visual_feedback: The Hostname field returns to placeholder text.
steps.intent_task: Clear the hostname field before adding or correcting the entry.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The add-host dialog is visible over the Your lists search screen.
steps.system_response: The dialog closes and a message appears saying the configuration changed and needs to be applied.
steps.visual_feedback: A snackbar appears near the bottom with the message: Your configuration changed. You need to apply it.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists search screen is visible with the search text still in the field and the keyboard open.
steps.system_response: The app begins leaving the search/list screen.
steps.visual_feedback: The top-left back arrow is pressed and the interface starts transitioning.
steps.intent_task: Exit search or return to the previous screen.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The AdAway home dashboard appears again with the red header and status cards.
steps.system_response: The app returns to the main AdAway dashboard.
steps.navigation_change: Your lists screen to AdAway home screen
steps.visual_feedback: The red AdAway dashboard becomes visible again.
steps.intent_task: Return to the main app screen after editing the list.

steps.what_screen_is_visible: The Your lists screen is visible again. One list item is visible with text that appears to read pol.
steps.system_response: The allowed-list screen is shown with one visible entry.
steps.navigation_change: AdAway home screen to Your lists screen
steps.visual_feedback: A list item appears under the Your lists title.
steps.intent_task: Review the allowed-list entry after making changes.

overall_flow: Submit or save the whitelist change
Open or view the list again
human_readable_step_summary: Step 1: The app opens on the AdAway home screen and the user goes toward the allowed-list area.
Step 2: The user taps the search icon on the Your lists screen.
Step 3: The user types a short search query into the hostname search field.
Step 4: The user taps the plus button to add a new host.
Step 5: The user types text into the add-host dialog.
Step 6: The user clears the text from the hostname field.
Step 7: The user submits the add-host dialog and the app shows that the configuration changed.
Step 8: The user taps the back arrow to leave the search/list screen.
Step 9: The app returns to the main AdAway dashboard.
Step 10: The app shows the Your lists screen again with one visible list item.
